runner_contract.format: Declarative scenario specification, not an existing runner API or executable script. Shared runner schema was not supplied; external adapter/mapping is required.
runner_contract.selectors: Names in selectors/procedures refer to data-testid unless CSS is explicitly given. Repeated order/item controls must be scoped to matching data-order-id/data-item-id.

procedures.open_customer: Click role-customer, select table-select as specified (01 default), click btn-open-menu. Selecting another table requires btn-open-menu to change session.
procedures.submit_valid_order: Select menu-item-m01, click btn-add-item, then btn-submit-order; record order-id and order-message. Do not use a disabled/closed/stale-price basket.
procedures.manager_count: Click role-manager; use mock demomanager / 0000 through staff-user, staff-pin, btn-login; click nav-capacity and record capacity-window. Return role-customer without resetting.
procedures.staff_login: Click role-staff and select demokitchen or demofront with mock PIN 0000, then btn-login. These are public fictional seed accounts.

adapters.seed_clock_before_script: External runner may load an in-memory copy with only #mock-seed JSON clock.initial replaced before script executes. Record original target hash, derived fixture hash and exact override; do not edit submitted artifacts. No public clock-set API exists.
adapters.advance_seconds: For second precision, external runner may set existing [data-action="advance"][data-minutes="1"] button data-minutes to seconds/60, click, and restore attribute to 1. This uses existing handler and changes only the test DOM; verify sim-clock exactly. Record adapter use. If unsupported, mark boundary case NOT_TESTED.

runner_contract.unsupported: Never substitute source inspection for runtime, invent adapter execution or import unseen legacy cases.

repeat_protocol.isolation: Every repetition runs every change case; each case/subcase uses fresh/reset state with its specified clock. Boundary fixtures each start isolated. No accumulation across repetitions.
repeat_protocol.required_result: Three independently observed successful suite repetitions; 3 orders is not 3 rounds. Not measured during execute.

scenarios.title: Fixed window boundary 12:00 +07:00
preconditions: Fresh isolated document for every boundary and repetition. Default capacity N=3, peak 11:30–13:30, X=10; no other fixture changes.
External fixture adapter is required for second precision and 11:59:59; if unavailable record NOT_TESTED, never round to a nearby minute.
steps: Load isolated fixture with seed.clock.initial=2026-01-01T11:59:59+07:00. Submit three valid orders at that timestamp; record confirmed timestamps and count=3 in previous window.
Open a new customer basket; capture warning before crossing boundary.
Use external runner advance_seconds(1) adapter so sim-clock becomes exactly 2026-01-01T12:00:00+07:00; inspect manager capacity-window and return to customer.
Verify old orders still exist but current window count=0 and warning absent. Submit one order exactly at the boundary; inspect count=1.
Submit two more orders at the same timestamp, open another customer basket and capture warning at count=3; submit fourth and inspect count=4.

At boundary window=[2026-01-01T12:00:00+07:00,2026-01-01T12:15:00+07:00), previous orders excluded; count=0 before new confirmation, count=1 after first boundary order.
The three orders only one second old are excluded from the new window: this distinguishes fixed windows from rolling 15 minutes.
At 3 new orders warning appears before confirmation and a fourth order remains accepted.
evidence_required: Record scenario ID, repetition, original artifact SHA-256, fixture overrides, action order, simulated timestamps, observed values, expected values and errors.
